summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: An actively-managed exchange-traded fund with a primary investment objective of current income and a secondary objective of capital appreciation. The fund is sub-advised by The London Company of Virginia and under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets in a concentrated portfolio of 25 to 35 income-producing equity and equity-related investments, such as common stocks, ADRs, preferred stocks, and REITs.
